svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.title: nrp-mcp 1.1 architecture: the researcher's laptop runs the AI assistant and nrp-mcp; nrp-mcp plans, checks rules, gets the person's approval and runs kubectl as them against NRP Nautilus; results go to their S3 bucket
svg.text: RESEARCHER'S LAPTOP (macOS / Linux / Windows) - nothing to install as admin
upload on exit (one-run signed policy, no keys)
results download: nrp_data down run=ID -> results/<run>/
Hermes, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code,
wired by `nrp-mcp client <app>` (full path, user scope, .bak)
nrp-mcp serve (one Go binary, 10 MCP tools)
Planning engine (pure code, no model calls)

g.text: the person's yes, bound to the plan hash

svg.text: every call: --context --namespace -o json, timeouts, manifests on stdin; never touches the token
CLI the person runs in a terminal

g.text: nrp-mcp setup kubectl + kubelogin + NRP config + sign-in
nrp-mcp s3 setup save S3 keys (hidden input)
nrp-mcp doctor every check; FAIL -> exact next step
nrp-mcp client <app> wire an AI app (7 supported)
nrp-mcp approve show approval code | kubectl passthrough

svg.text: only namespaces you belong to; no cluster-wide writes
quotas, limit ranges, NRP admission policies
every object labelled managed-by + owner-id + run id

g.text: code ConfigMap mounted read-only at /code, unpacked to /work
pinned image (python, pytorch, tensorflow, jax, rocker, jupyter...)
limits = requests, 10Gi scratch; CPU sweeps kept off GPU nodes
no namespace API token mounted; secrets only via Secrets
results/ uploaded by an EXIT trap in the same container
(unknown custom images: small curl sidecar instead)

svg.text: NRP Ceph S3 - your results bucket
keys from nrp.ai/s3token stay on the laptop; no keys = job refused (R23)
A typical run (nrp_guide tells the assistant which step a person is on)
